name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted platform for file storage, sharing, synchronization and collaboration, with spaces, share links, WebDAV and desktop sync, backed by MariaDB.

alerts.message: An administrator account is created on first start with the login "admin" and the generated INIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Change the password after the first login. If you change both the login "admin" and the email "admin@sync-in.com" of this account, a new "admin" account is created the next time the container is recreated; remove INIT_ADMIN from the compose file to avoid it.
